concerns.text: The three Edge Cases specify MUST behaviors (log warning and halt on empty API result; filter rows with undeterminable oxidation states and log excluded count; raise ValueError when dataset <50 samples) but no FR covers any of them. FR-006 covers only descriptor gaps, not empty result sets or the minimum-sample guard. Add FRs (e.g., FR-007..FR-009) anchoring these edge-case behaviors so they are implementable and testable.
